title: src/adopt shrinks to the 2,450 lines S28 promised
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/prune/inventory.md (2026-11-21): src/adopt is 3,117 lines, S28 promised <= 2,450 (t-6rxzd3s closed without reaching it); adopt.ts 1,022 and verify.ts 1,015 lines with 15 exports for 4 callers.
Outcome: find src/adopt -name '*.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l prints <= 2450 with npm run fast PASS and no adopt test removed without its behaviour removed.
Proof: the wc command above and npm run fast.
Files: src/adopt/

Lane 2026-11-21: duplicates folded (3,117 -> 3,105, branch origin/t-ts97dd6 3f5f605, fast PASS, not shipped: see the untracked-record defect). The remaining ~650 lines are features with tests, so the cut needs a usage decision per feature: init.ts remediateHost/syncLockfile/writeCi + gaps.ts (~200, ADR 0023 point 4 'fold or go'), canary adoption overlay (~90), first-turn.ts (115), deploy.ts (195), journal.ts rollback (107), go/rust/php/wp-plugin stacks in init.ts. Evidence of use (callers in adopted repos, ledger) decides each.
